title: Personal Issues (Hard Version)
statement: The task asks for the optimal score difference in a tree game with n ≤ 2·10^5: from zeros x and y, players alternately zero a vertex, scoring when exactly one neighbor is zero. The value is 0 or 1, set by which x–y path vertex survives as the path shrinks from both ends; only hanging-subtree size parities matter, and a linear scan outward from the path's center decides it.
